verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows generic integrations (Slack, PagerDuty, webhooks, third-party API) and issue status/ownership docs, but nothing specifically documents Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear integration with two-way status sync (resolve ticket → resolve error, regression reopens both). Missing for 10: explicit Jira/GitHub Issues/Linear integration docs, evidence of two-way status sync behavior, and any confirmation that regressions reopen linked tickets.
